SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-14-2011 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-14-2011 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: JEAN MILEFF. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-14-2011 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CLARK, KRISTA-SIMONE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT KNOP, ROMAN DBA HYDE INVESTMENTS $1,900.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,950.00, DEFENDANT FAILED TO GIVE PLAINTIFF WRITTEN NOTICE OF RIGHT TO REQUEST INSPECTION AND DID NOT GIVE PLAINTIFF OPPORTUNITY TO REMEDY ALLEDGED DEFICIENCIES,CCP 1950.5(F)(1)(3). DEFENDANT DID NOT PROVIDE ITEMIZED STATEMENT STATING BASIS FOR RETAINING PORTION OF SECURITY DEPOSIT WITHIN 21 DAYS PLAINITFF'S VACANCY. (CCP 1950.5 (G)(1). DEFENDANT FAILED TO MEET HIS OBLIGATIONS UNDER CCP 1950.5 AND RETENTION OF SECURITY DEPOSIT WAS IN BAD FAITH AND PLAINTIFF IS ENTITLED TO DOUBLE DAMAGES CCP 1950.5(L). STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
